documents.title: Disclosure of Voting results of Postal Ballot (Regulation 44(3) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015)

analysis.summary: Wheels India Limited presented its Q1 FY27 investor presentation reporting consolidated gross revenues of Rs 1,492.79 Cr and consolidated net profit of Rs 38.94 Cr. Management outlined strategic focus areas including growing exports, ramping up cast aluminium and wind energy components, and optimizing working capital. Capex for FY27 is estimated between Rs 400 to Rs 450 crores. Wheels India Limited reported a strong Q4 FY26 performance with 23% revenue growth and a 45% increase in PAT, supported by favorable tailwinds like GST 2.0, stable commodity prices, and relative lowering of interest rates. For the full year, the company crossed INR5,000 crores in revenue for the first time with a 16% growth over the previous year.

guidance.claim: Capex for FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

guidance.claim: Management expects capex for the current year to be between INR280 crores and INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: And we expect in the current year, it will be between INR280 crores to INR300 crores of capex.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching double-digit EBITDA over the next one or two years.
guidance.quote: So I think as and when that happens, I think we're probably 2 years away -- 1 or 2 years away from double-digit EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Capex for FY27 is estimated to be between Rs. 280 and Rs. 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 280 to Rs 300 crs

demand_outlook.claim: Customer forecasts indicate they are not overly positive about the immediate future.
demand_outlook.quote: And also judging by the investor calls of our customers, who are also known to your community, they are not super positive about the immediate future.

demand_outlook.claim: Tata's and Mahindra's have been very guarded about growth in the coming year.
demand_outlook.quote: So -- and even our customers, if you look at Tata's or Mahindra's, who have both been in the news recently, they've been very guarded about the growth in the coming year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recorded historical annual capex values ranging from Rs 129.63 Cr up to Rs 261.84 Cr between 2021-22 and 2025-26.
The company spent approximately INR261 crores towards capex last year.
capex_expansion.quote: In terms of capex, last year, we basically spent about INR261 crores towards capex, which is both in terms of investment towards the windmill business, aluminium business and a little bit of the off-road businesses and some routine capex and cost savings totalling INR261 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Board-approved capex for financial year 2026-27 is approximately INR280 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: One is the capex approved for the Board is about INR280 crores at the moment.

capex_expansion.claim: Aluminium wheel capacity is scheduled to increase to 60,000 in a few months and then to 80,000 by the half year.
capex_expansion.quote: We are increasing it -- in a few months we are increasing it to 60,000 and then by half year, we'll increase it to 80,000.

capex_expansion.claim: FY26 capex was mainly directed towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium and steel wheels, earth mover and big agri wheels, alongside routine capex and cost-saving projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of FY26 is mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium & steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA percentage was reported at 7.79%.
Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA percentage stood at 7.79%.
The company booked a net forex profit of about INR4 crores in the current quarter and close to INR10 crores for the full year.
margins_costs.quote: So in the current quarter, we had a profit of about INR4 crores as a net thing on the forex. And for the whole year, it is about close to INR10 crores as forex gain.

margins_costs.claim: Interest cost for the year totaled approximately INR111 crores.
margins_costs.quote: See, the present interest cost is around INR26 crores, INR27 crores a quarter, totalling about INR111 crores for the whole year.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization with a thrust on profitability is part of the key strategies and focus areas going forward.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined passenger car steel wheel capacity between the company and its subsidiary is approximately 11 million to 12 million.
orders_capacity.quote: So if you take passenger car, steel wheels between us and our subsidiary, if I look at it combined, I think Wheels India has got a capacity of about 4 million and the subsidiary has got a capacity of about 7 million. So about 11 million to 12 million is the capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Commercial vehicle wheel capacity, including light commercial vehicles, stands at about 250,000.
orders_capacity.quote: Commercial vehicle space, if you look at it, we have a capacity -- including the light commercial vehicle, if you look at it, we have about 250,000 capacity and we'll probably look at increasing that to 300,000 capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity for aluminum wheels is approximately 42,000 per month.
orders_capacity.quote: In aluminium wheels we currently have a capacity of about 42,000 per month.

capital_allocation.claim: Consolidated debt as of 30.06.2026 was reported at Rs 710 Cr.
Inventory days were reduced from 76 days to 63 days.
capital_allocation.quote: So we've reduced our inventory from 76 days to 63 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Debtor days were reduced from 61 days to 54 days.
capital_allocation.quote: We have reduced our debtor days from 61 to 54.

capital_allocation.claim: Free Cash Flow stands at Rs. 83 crores in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Free Cash Flow (FCF) stands at 83Crs in FY26

capital_allocation.claim: Debt is maintained at FY25 levels.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt is maintained at FY25 levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated plans to grow exports of wheels for construction equipment and agricultural tractors.
management_commitments.quote:  Grow exports of wheels for construction equipment and agricultural tractors

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to ramp-up the expanded facility for machining of large castings for windmills and step up capacity for fabricated, structural parts for windmills.
management_commitments.quote:

Management targets to ramp-up the cast aluminium wheel business.
Management intends to fund capex predominantly through accruals and hold debt at current levels.
management_commitments.quote: • Fund capex predominantly thro accruals and holding the debt at current levels

management_commitments.quote: I think as and when that happens, I think we're probably 2 years away -- 1 or 2 years away from double-digit EBITDA. I don't think it should take longer than that.

management_commitments.claim: Aluminum wheel capacity is planned to increase to 60,000 in a few months and to 80,000 by the half year.
management_commitments.quote: We are increasing it -- in a few months we are increasing it to 60,000 and then by half year, we'll increase it to 80,000.
